description: This Java source file defines the ContentMapFacade class, which implements a Map interface for managing content-related data, such as retrieving content, subcontent, metadata, handling rendering, and linking within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class representing content data, providing access to content entity and related content mapping.

classes.name: SubContent
classes.description: Inner class managing subcontent entities with sorting and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Inner class providing access to metadata associated with the content.

classes.name: DataResource
classes.description: Inner class managing data resource objects linked to content, allowing retrieval and rendering.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the map, which is 1.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the map is empty, always false.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the map contains a key, always false.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the map, always false.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns fixed set of keys relevant to content mapping.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for subcontent retrieval.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Main access method retrieves various content elements such as fields, links, subcontent, metadata, content, or renders content based on key.

methods.name: renderThis
methods.description: Handles rendering of the content object, respecting render flags and possible decoration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the rendered string of the content.
